issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 default 150f 渲染，比卡片 md 的 ~4.7s 多出 9f 空尾
画面上方打着调试标题 AXIAL STRETCH，背景是纯色灰底
落位目标是三个 2px 灰色虚线框，像线框稿而不是真实页面槽位（Q9）
卡片飞行时阴影与静置时完全一样，拉伸只有形变、没有离面高度
落点只有形变回弹，槽位本身对'被撞到'没有任何反应
changes: 补导出 AXIAL_STRETCH_DURATION = 141（≈4.7s）：首卡 f10 起飞，末卡 f78 回弹完，真静止 62f；拉伸映射 / 错峰 / 回弹参数不变
去掉调试标题；三张卡落进一块真实的 'Pinned reports' 面板：受光白面 + 发丝线 + 两层软阴影，标题栏带图标与随落位递增的 0/3→3/3 计数
虚线框换成凹槽（浅填充 + 双层内阴影 + 发丝线），落定前槽内显示对应卡名占位
卡片阴影高度随速度从 4 抬到 22（飞得快 = 离面高），落定收回静置阴影
落点那一帧槽位外沿泛起一圈强调色描边并在 16f 内扩散淡出（每张一次，只给落点）；柔光浅底 + 颗粒
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench used the 150f default, 9f longer than the card's ~4.7s
A debug title AXIAL STRETCH sat at the top over a flat grey background
Landing targets were three 2px dashed grey boxes, wireframe-like rather than real page slots (Q9)
Card shadows were identical in flight and at rest; the stretch was pure deformation with no sense of lift
Only the card squashed on landing; the slot showed no reaction to being hit
changesEn: Exported AXIAL_STRETCH_DURATION = 141 (~4.7s): first card launches at f10, last finishes its rebound at f78, then a 62f true hold; stretch mapping, stagger and rebound unchanged
Removed the debug title; cards land in a real 'Pinned reports' panel: top-lit surface, hairline, two-layer shadow, header with icon and a 0/3→3/3 count that ticks per landing
Dashed boxes became recessed wells (light fill, two inset shadows, hairline) showing the matching card name until filled
Card shadow elevation rises from 4 to 22 with speed (faster = higher off the surface) and settles back on landing
On impact the slot edge emits one accent ring that expands and fades over 16f (once per card, only at landing); soft-lit light backdrop with grain
